name: Delighted (by Qualtrics)
oneLiner: Simple NPS/CSAT survey tool owned by Qualtrics, retired on June 30, 2026.
bestFor: No longer available; former users were directed to Qualtrics or other survey tools.

updates.text: Qualtrics shut Delighted down: monthly subscriptions were prorated to end June 30, 2026, customer access ended by July 1, 2026, and customer data was to be deleted after the sunset.
Annual renewals stopped as part of the announced sunset; Qualtrics offered a Delighted + Qualtrics Graduation Program to move customers to its platform.

features: (Historical) NPS, CSAT, CES, 5-star, smiley and thumbs survey formats
(Historical) Distribution by email, SMS, web, link and kiosk
(Historical) Integrations with tools such as Salesforce, Slack, HubSpot and Zendesk

pricing.text: No longer sold; the product was sunset on June 30, 2026.

notes: SUNSET: Delighted was retired by Qualtrics on June 30, 2026 (one FAQ version says access terminated July 1, 2026). Remove it from the survey software list or replace it. The '2025-07' date for annual renewals ending comes from third-party migration guides (e.g. SmartSurvey) citing the FAQ; the Graduation Program page itself is undated. Dropped from the current review: customer list (DoorDash, Instacart, OpenTable, Allbirds), pricing (free 25 responses, $99 and $249/month), 37 languages and 30+ integrations, all obsolete after the shutdown.
